name: reskin
title_zh: 为可换肤应用写一套全新领域皮肤
tagline_zh: 品牌、主题、布局、页面、工具、数据、Agent 一键全换。不是改样式，是换掉整个应用体验，让销售演示活起来。
tagline_en: Swap brand, theme, layout, pages, tools, data, and agent in one shot. Not a reskin—a full experience transplant.
desc_en: Author a NEW skin for the reskinnable-demo app. A skin is a self-contained domain plugin under src/skins/<id>/ that implements the frozen `Skin` contract (src/shell/skin-contract.ts) to swap the app's entire experience — brand, theme, layout, pages, tools, data, and agent — as a live sales demo. Use when the user says "add a skin", "create a skin", "new skin", "reskin the app", "make a <domain> sk
why_zh: 皮肤实现冻结的 Skin 契约，领域逻辑自包含，不污染主应用。换肤即换产品，演示时像换幻灯片一样干净利。
why_en: Each skin implements a frozen contract, keeping domain logic self-contained. Swap the whole product like flipping a slide—zero.
